title: Smoked Paella with Chorizo
description: A traditional Spanish dish with smoky flavors and spicy chorizo. Serve with a side of fresh vegetables for a hearty meal.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chorizo and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
3. Remove the chorizo from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
6. Add the diced red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
7. Add the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
8. Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
9. Add the cooked chorizo and artichoke hearts back to the skillet.
10. Stir in the nourishing long-grain rice.
11. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
